trap-superlative.notes: STRUCTURAL (meaning change). Proposed: The down-up dressed mass splitting is determined by the substrate flavor formula up to O((Delta m/M_N)^2). RIGOR (reported, not fixed - MAJOR, a live convention-C leak in a physical prediction). (1) THE TWO DISPLAYS AGREE ONLY IN CONVENTION C. Display 1 carries the half-power factor (q^{1/2}+q^{-1/2})/(q+q^{-1}); display 2 carries 1/z_mkv. These are algebraically identical iff 1/z = q^{1/2}+q^{-1/2}, i.e. z = sqrt(q)/(q+1) = z_C - the convention excised by the owner ruling of 2026-08-15. Verified symbolically: (1-q^{-4})/(q+q^{-1}) = (q^2-1)/q^3 = (q-q^{-1})/q^2 = hbar_q^2 h_q/(q-1)^2 . 3/M_N ... i.e. the two displays match term by term once 1/z_C is substituted. Verified numerically at 30 dps with M_N = 938.91875 MeV, proton pin q_0 = 1.1099785827513808: display 1 = 1.286429856 MeV; display 2 with z_C = 1.286429856 (residual 3.9e-31, identical); display 2 with the CANONICAL z_D = q^3/(q^2+1) = 1.048397466 MeV, differing by 0.238 MeV (18.5%). Same at the muon pin to 7 figures. Proposed: re-derive under convention D and state which z_mkv is meant; as printed the block asserts an equality between two expressions that are not equal in the canonical convention. (2) CONTEXT, reported neutrally: the convention-C value 1.28643 MeV sits 0.53% below the CODATA neutron-proton mass difference 1.29333 MeV. Given that the block's own closing sentence emphasises that Delta_np is no longer an input, a reader will read that agreement as the result; it should be stated explicitly as a comparison, with the convention it depends on. (3) VERIFIED CORRECT: hbar_q = 1 - q^{-1} and h_q = q - q^{-1} are used consistently with AGENTS.md, and mu_d - mu_u is a SPLITTING, so it is within the post-2026-08-11 reportable class (not an excised absolute mass).
